disambiguation: Not just a simple assistant, it functions as a comprehensive writing studio covering plot management, focus tracking, and data analysis.
extras: The plugin is fully local, with dictionary updates performed via API only when manually triggered. It supports both English and Chinese.
problem: Novel and story writers require integrated tools for tracking word count, managing complex plot elements, and maintaining focus during long writing sessions.

relations.evidence: Real-time writing stats in OBS | Floating word count & focus timer widget

summary: An all-in-one writing studio for novel and story writers that provides word count tracking, timeline management, and immersive writing modes.
